title: What Is Your Work Style Archetype?
description: Answer 4 simple questions to discover how you naturally process problems, organize tasks, and execute ideas.

questions.text: When handed an ambiguous project, what is your first impulse?

options.label: Brainstorm wild concepts without setting constraints.
Map out a granular timeline and break down sub-tasks.

questions.text: How do you prefer to present recommendations to a group?

options.label: Focus on high-level narrative, vision, and possibilities.
Provide rigorous data points, metrics, and risk assessments.

questions.text: What causes you the most frustration during a workflow?

options.label: Lack of documentation and moving goalposts.

questions.text: Which environment brings out your absolute best output?

options.label: A blank canvas with room for big-picture strategy.
A structured problem space requiring optimization and precision.

architect.title: The Strategic Architect
architect.description: You operate best at 30,000 feet. You synthesize abstract concepts quickly, spot macro patterns before others do, and excel at charting direction where clear roadmaps don't yet exist.

analyst.title: The Systematic Analyst
analyst.description: You are a master of execution and structural precision. You turn chaos into order, spot critical operational flaws, and ensure plans are backed by verifiable logic and structure.
